{"data":{"issue":{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","identifier":"TRK-1","title":"app: Starting stack validation on the create room form","description":"## Where we are Groomed lean at 1 point on 2026-10-31 as the real Story for Pod Dogfood A (TRK-2, S8b). poker-room main is at 7fa3a38. It is driven by Pod on host-a through `impl-small@1`, not by `/kick-off`, under the same exception TRK-3 granted TRK-4: the Pod Run's implement and review Tasks are `orca orchestration worker-start` Dispatches, the Story carries the estimate and the gates itself, and HQA runs on the PR, not after a deploy. Nothing starts until S8a (Pod brief counters) merges. `src/client/__tests__/createStack.test.ts` is a path this ticket adds, so `proves` printed it absent. Proved: 0 callers, 0 fakes, 0 asserting tests, 2/2 checks fail today, origin/main 7fa3a38 2026-10-31 ## Goal On the create room page, a starting stack that is not a whole number of chips, is zero or negative, or is smaller than ten big blinds keeps the submit button disabled and names the problem in the help text, and the preview card shows what the host typed, not the 1000 fallback. Today `readCreateForm` turns any bad stack into 1000 silently and the room is created with it. ## Constraints * Files in scope: `public/create.html`, `public/js/create.js`, `src/client/__tests__/createForm.test.ts`, and the new `src/client/__tests__/createStack.test.ts`. The server keeps `defaultStack: Number(src.defaultStack) || CREATE_DEFAULTS.defaultStack` in `src/server/parseCreateRoomBody.ts`; do not change it. * `readCreateForm` returns the typed value: `defaultStack` is `Number(stackRaw)` with no `|| 1000` fallback, and `NaN` stays `NaN` so the validator sees it. * `stackProblem(body)` beside `blindsProblem(body)` returns one of: `Starting stack must be a whole number of chips.` (not an integer or not finite), `Starting stack must be above 0.`, `Starting stack must be at least ten big blinds ().` with the number filled in, or an empty string. A help line `

` under the stack input shows the problem or the default text `Chips each player starts with.`; the submit button is disabled while `blindsProblem(body) || stackProblem(body)` is non-empty, in the same `refresh` path the blinds use. * The preview card's Starting stack row shows the typed value when it is a whole number, including a bad one, and `—` when it is not a number. * Tests use Vitest and happy-dom, following `src/client/__tests__/createForm.test.ts`: `stackProblem` for each message and the empty case; the submit button disabled on 0, 2.5, blank, and 150 with blinds 10/20, and enabled on 200; the preview row text for 750 and for blank. `npm test` and `npm run build` pass. * One PR to `main` opened by the Pod Run's `pr` Task after the review Task's PASS. The reviewer never pushes or merges. keeper merges on his HQA PR review PASS, posted as a `merge PASS` verdict comment on this Story so Pod records the gate receipt. * No deploy in this ticket. The Run's `deploy` and `hqa` steps stay unfilled and the brief reports them as such; whether the merged change ships follows the normal poker-room release path afterwards. ## Completion check * `grep -q stackProblem public/js/create.js` and `test -f src/client/__tests__/createStack.test.ts` both exit 0 (both fail today). * `npm test` exits 0 with the cases in Constraints; `npm run build` exits 0. * The Pod ledger for this Story shows the implement, review, and pr Tasks, the push and pr events, the review gate receipt, and the merge gate receipt, with no hand-written entry (S8b's check). * Owner keeper: HQA PR review on the PR, recorded as `merge PASS` on this Story. ## Exclusions * No server-side validation change and no `CREATE_DEFAULTS` change. * No change to seats, blinds, or game name handling. * No deploy and no HQA after deploy. ## Source and links * Source of truth: trk-dev/poker-room at 7fa3a38, `public/js/create.js` `readCreateForm` and `blindsProblem`, `public/create.html` lines 104 to 107; TRK-4 as the pattern. * Story: this ticket (no stage children, as TRK-4) * PRD: none * Design: none * Related: TRK-2 (Pod S8 Dogfood A), TRK-4 (the Orca-only POC story this one is compared with) ## Gates | Gate | Type | Gatekeeper | Status | | -- | -- | -- | -- | | Tech design review | AQA | crew (reviewer) | skipped | | PR review | AQA | crew (reviewer) | pending | | HQA PR review | HQA | keeper | pending | | HQA after deploy | HQA | keeper | skipped | Skipped: Tech design review, routine: two files, no shared interface, no data model change Skipped: HQA after deploy, no deploy in this ticket; HQA runs on the PR under the TRK-3 exception ## Checkpoints - [ ] `stackProblem`, the help line, the preview row, and the tests ## Kickoff Kickoff: lean Groomed with: lean","estimate":1,"state":{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002","name":"Todo","type":"unstarted"},"labels":{"nodes":[{"name":"app"},{"name":"story"},{"name":"stage:impl"},{"name":"driver:keeper"}]},"team":{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003","key":"trk","states":{"nodes":[{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004","name":"HQA","type":"started"},{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005","name":"Pending-groom","type":"backlog"},{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006","name":"Story-verified","type":"started"},{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007","name":"In-review","type":"started"},{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008","name":"Done","type":"completed"},{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002","name":"Todo","type":"unstarted"},{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009","name":"Doing","type":"started"},{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010","name":"Canceled","type":"canceled"},{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011","name":"Backlog","type":"backlog"},{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012","name":"Duplicate","type":"duplicate"}]}}}}}
